Great tool!!! Just don’t rely on it Alone
I’ve been backpacking for about 35 years (except during my time in the military), so I grew up navigating with maps, compasses, and terrain reading. That said, I actually enjoy having a piece of outdoor tech like AllTrails in my kit. It’s great for discovering routes, finding trailheads, and helping keep you on the trail when things get confusing.

That said, it’s not perfect. I’ve noticed the mileage can be off. On a recent trip the valley I was hiking to was measured at about 8.1 miles, but when my Garmin and AllTrails both showed 8 miles, I still hadn’t even reached the saddle yet. This has happened more than once.

I also recently ran into a snow conditions issue. The trailhead was completely dry so I left my snowshoes in the car, but about 5–6 miles in I hit 2–3 feet of snow. That was fun! 

I like the app and use it regularly, but people should still carry a map and compass and know how to use them, especially for backpacking.

One feature I’d love to see added is the ability to add grids like UTM or MGRS overlay for better backcountry navigation.

Great tool—just not a replacement for experience and training.
